en: A sepia-toned postcard showing ancient Egyptian ruins with massive stone columns and seated colossal statues. A person in traditional clothing stands near the base of one statue, emphasizing the scale of the architecture. The scene is framed by a beige border with a handwritten-style caption at the bottom and a small number at the lower left. A modern watermark with the URL 'www.elia.org.gr' is superimposed across the lower right.
